summary: This document is a 'Two Wheeler Policy- Bundled Policy Wording' issued by Raheja QBE General Insurance Company Limited. It outlines the terms, conditions, and coverage details for motor vehicle insurance, including Section I (Loss of or Damage to the Vehicle Insured) and Section II (Liabilities to Third Parties). The document specifies the insurer's details, policy period, sum insured (IDV), depreciation rates, exclusions, and conditions for claims. It also includes tables for depreciation schedules and details on third-party liability coverage.
